source.registry_document: 2026 June - Compiled Rule Book Master v1 - reduced size.pdf
source.quote_free_summary: Each round recalls at least half the couples; fewer is allowed only when the actual recall would force an extra round; a 50% second-round recall carries forward to the third round.

requirement: Enforce the 50% minimum recall in every round including the verified exceptions and the carry-forward, and record which exception applied.
enforcement_point: Not built. NDCA advancement support is NOT IMPLEMENTED and a BLOCKER to NDCA scoring-profile activation (OD-09). Docs-only record: nothing implemented, no test, no compliance claimed.
interpretation_notes: Today only target >= 2 and <= round capacity (<=100) is enforced; no percentage rule, no exception handling, no carry-forward. The exact exception semantics (what counts as requiring an additional round) must be re-read and confirmed in the engine design before implementation.
decision_refs: OD-09 (owner decision 2026-11-23, Option C now / Option A required for a future NDCA scoring profile; retrospective audit PR #795)
